name: Zigpoll
description: Query survey results, run response analytics, and build and distribute Zigpoll surveys from your OpenClaw agent.

apiKey.description: Zigpoll private API key. Create one at app.zigpoll.com under Settings > Manage Integrations > API Key.

defaultAccountId.description: Optional Zigpoll account ID used when a tool call omits account_id. Find it with the zigpoll_list_accounts tool.

digest.description: Tuning for the zigpoll_response_digest tool used by scheduled check-ins.

lookbackDays.description: Max days a digest looks back after downtime (default 7, max 30).

maxResponsesPerCheck.description: Max responses fetched per digest check (default 500, max 1000).
